# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet lines, one per worker."""

from typing import Iterable, List
from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError

def timesheet_lines(shifts: Iterable[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, busiest (most hours) first."""
    shifts = list(shifts)
    if not shifts:
        raise ProjectError("no shifts to report")
    if any(not item.worker.strip() for item in shifts):
        raise ProjectError("shift has a blank worker name")
    counts = {}
    for item in shifts:
        counts[item.worker] = counts.get(item.worker, 0) + 1
    totals = worker_minutes(shifts)
    ranked = sorted(
        totals, key=lambda name: (-totals[name], name)
    )
    return [
        f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, "
        f"{totals[name] / 60:.1f} hours"
        for name in ranked
    ]
